entities.name: 创始人市场匹配度 (founder market fit)
entities.how_described: 本集说创始人市场匹配度确实重要，但很多连续创业者会拿它当借口卡住自己，觉得得有十年领域经验才配动手，实际上选一个好奇的方向深入钻研就能快速建立认知

evidence.quote: It's true that founder market fit matters.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 智能体 (agents)
entities.how_described: 本集在举例时提到「为清洁服务构建语音客服智能体（voice customer service agents）」，仅作为假设场景一笔带过

evidence.quote: Say you want to build voice customer service agents for cleaning services.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 模型能力的边缘 (edge of what models can do)
entities.how_described: 本集说好想法应处在模型今天能做的事情的边缘——产品在当前前沿模型上勉强能用，但模型一进步就明显变好，你要清楚卡住产品性能的瓶颈是什么

evidence.quote: The first is that the idea sits at the edge of what models can do today.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 垂直化 (verticalize)
entities.how_described: 本集说 AI 时代好想法应该垂直化，最终卖结果而不是卖软件——别给保险公司做软件，直接当保险商；别给银行做后台系统，直接当银行

evidence.quote: The second quality of a good idea is that it should verticalize.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: SaaS
entities.how_described: 本集在说「追求最雄心勃勃的版本」时提到可以挑战价值 100 亿美元的遗留 SaaS 公司，仅一笔带过

evidence.quote: Or taking on very large incumbents like a $10 billion legacy SaaS company.
